case_slice: Nested series propagation of a passive parallel switchover and terminal fault

parent.accepted_scope: one operated of B/A/C, B→A→C with two noncritical failures and mission success

topology_template.usage: RBDSeries and RBDSeriesStructure column schemas only; source is derived from the G05 parent

model.passive_child: G05-PASSIVE: NBREQ=NBOP=1, POS-B PRIO1 operated, POS-A PRIO2 passive, TSWOV=0.5h, ONLM=N
model.failures: unchanged FM-POS-B 600000 and FM-POS-A 300000 per million operating hours; POS-C has no mode
model.repair: unchanged half-hour direct system CM after return

source_delta: Keep every material, failure, mission, seed, report and repair row. Move POS-C from passive priority-3 branch to a nonfailing series leaf. Set the system operating-mode root to G05-ROOT-SERIES, add RBDSeries and RBDSeriesStructure rows, and update descriptions. The nested child uses OPMID=null as in the installed manual p770 example.
manual_basis: Installed SIMLOX 2017 manual pp197–200 and 455–458 define passive parallel operation and switch state; p770 provides a nested block encoding with null OPMID. The direct G05 parent and G04 nested template are independently accepted CLI packages.

pre_run_hypotheses.first_failure: If fixed-seed draws remain stable, operated B fails around h8.94145 and B→A switches over 0.5h. The nested series system should carry an observable switchover state without treating nonfailing C as a standby replacement.
pre_run_hypotheses.second_failure: If activated A fails around h17.5636, the two-branch passive child has no functional branch, so the series root should become unavailable/critical and the mission should abort. Do not preaccept exact event times if the topology changes draws.
pre_run_hypotheses.alternative: If source import rejects nested placement, if POS-C remains in the passive child, or if the log/report lacks a traceable nested state, retain as a diagnostic probe and do not publish G05.var06.
pre_run_hypotheses.observability: Require raw B→A start/stop, root/aircraft state timeline, A failure and mission outcome; reconcile half-hour SystemResults switch, unavailable/operating, failure, repair and stock bins. Summary success alone is insufficient.

acceptance_gates: Frozen parent, template, input and exact six-table topology delta; installed source hashes
Session-0 SSH with sshd ancestor, host-wide native mutex, preserved GUI PID 13340, unique run directory
Native import/export/calc/report, exact authored-row roundtrip and zero converter errors
Event-level and report-bin proof of nested switch state and terminal fault propagation, with independent read-only replay
Raw invocation, logs, model, report and closure SHA-256 seals in evidence index
limits: One fixed seed and repetition, one two-branch passive child under a nonfailing series leg, and one chosen 0.5h switch do not establish a general nested RBD truth table.
This case does not resolve unavailable preferred standby G05.var04 or overlapping switches G05.var05.
GUI RBD rendering and cross-engine equivalence remain unverified.
